title: East & North Bengaluru Sustenance Drive
menu: Warm steamed turmeric rice, farm eggs, chicken broth, and puppy kibble
description: Roksh volunteers deployed mobile vehicle units carrying large heavy-gauge food cauldrons. The drive focused on desolate industrial routes where community animals face chronic food scarcity on weekends.
highlights: Large cauldrons prepped fresh early morning
Special meal portions for lactating mothers and young pups
Field health checks performed during distribution

title: Monsoon Relief & Street Nourishment
menu: Cooked rice with protein broth, served in clean individual bowls
description: Heavy monsoon rains often leave street animals shivering and without access to scavenged food. Our team operates regular feeding routes using clean bowls to ensure safe, hygienic feeding without littering streets.
highlights: Individual clean purple bowls used to prevent contamination
Friendly socialization and trust-building with shy street dogs
Identification of dogs needing wound treatment

title: Community Feeding & Health Observation
menu: High-protein meal mix, boiled eggs, calcium fortified broth
description: A scheduled weekend initiative combining meal distribution with general wellness observation, deworming tablet administration, and citizen education on peaceful community co-existence.
highlights: Spot deworming administered with food for safe consumption
Engaging local shopkeepers to encourage daily water bowl placement
Record keeping for regular pack dynamics
